hooks.command: repo=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); coherence() { if [ -z "$repo" ]; then exit 0; fi; cli="$repo/mnemion-js/node_modules/@posthog/coherence/dist/cli.js"; if [ ! -f "$cli" ]; then if [ "$2" = SessionStart ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Coherence is configured but dependencies are not installed in mnemion-js."}'; fi; exit 0; fi; cd "$repo/mnemion-js" || exit 78; /bin/sh "$repo/scripts/coherence-root-hook.sh" "$cli" "$@"; }; coherence hook SessionStart
